context:
Goal: a grant typed in one session reaches the session it names.
Problem (rule): your ruling fixes the catalogue as `merge <pr>` and self-edit, but self-edit gates nothing and the classifier still refused a merge, and only you can change your own ruling.
Based on (ruling): decision grant-reaches-lanes, ruling 3 (Nov 3, 18:21 CST), names `merge <pr>` and self-edit as the first catalogue.
Based on (measured): docs/plans/grant-reaches-lanes.md section 2 (Nov 6) found that self-edit gates nothing; the classifier refused `merge 1421 --confirm` on Nov 7, 13:05 CST.
Departs from: ruling 3's catalogue (merge <pr>, self-edit) — d swaps self-edit for the lane's agent spawn.
You asked on Nov 10, 09:06 CST why the order matters. It does not: "first" only named which acts the catalogue holds. Option d is new.
Meanwhile: #2517 lands the plan and the decision as you signed them, and nothing past the probe is built.
